open.purpose: Button that opens the guided send.
open.where: Overview screen, when the Library has tracks.

title.where: Send checklist (opens in the Overview's place), heading.

close.purpose: Button that closes the guided send.

warning.purpose: Warns the user not to play or edit in rekordbox until the import is done.
warning.where: Send checklist, under the title, always shown.
warning.approved: Don't play or edit in rekordbox from the export until the import is finished. Changes made in between will be lost.

trackWithArtist.purpose: How a track with an artist is named in the send lists.
trackWithArtist.where: Send checklist, review step and its lists ({{title}} and {{artist}} come from the track).

more_one.purpose: Says one more row isn't shown.
more_one.where: Send checklist, end of a list cut off after 50 rows (one more).

more_other.purpose: Says how many more rows aren't shown.
more_other.where: Send checklist, end of a list cut off after 50 rows.

export.title.purpose: Title of step one, getting the export from rekordbox.

export.howTo.purpose: Tells the user how to export the collection and read it.
export.howTo.where: Send checklist, step 1, under its title.
export.howTo.approved: In rekordbox, choose File > Export Collection in xml format. Then read the export here.

export.noneChosen.purpose: Says no rekordbox export is chosen yet.
export.noneChosen.where: Send checklist, step 1, in place of the file path.

export.choose.purpose: Button that picks an export file.
export.choose.where: Send checklist, step 1, while no export is chosen.

export.chooseAnother.purpose: Button that picks a different export file.
export.chooseAnother.where: Send checklist, step 1, once an export is chosen.

export.read.purpose: Button that reads the chosen export.
export.read.where: Send checklist, step 1, once an export is chosen.

export.reading.purpose: Says the export is being read.
export.reading.where: Send checklist, step 1, status while the read runs.

export.saved.purpose: Says when the export file was saved.
export.saved.where: Send checklist, step 1, status after a read ({{when}} is a date and time).

export.fileFilter.purpose: Name of the file type in the picker's file-type list.
export.fileFilter.where: The system file picker opened by Choose export, file-type filter for .xml.

review.title.purpose: Title of step two, reviewing what will be sent.

review.notYet.purpose: Says the export hasn't been read yet, so there's nothing to review.
review.notYet.where: Send checklist, step 2, before a read.

review.new_one.purpose: Says one new track will be sent.
review.new_one.where: Send checklist, step 2, count of tracks rekordbox doesn't have.

review.new_other.purpose: Says how many new tracks will be sent.
review.new_other.where: Send checklist, step 2, count of tracks rekordbox doesn't have.

review.known_one.purpose: Says one track to be sent is already in rekordbox.
review.known_one.where: Send checklist, step 2, count of tracks rekordbox has.

review.known_other.purpose: Says how many tracks to be sent are already in rekordbox.
review.known_other.where: Send checklist, step 2, count of tracks rekordbox has.

review.nothing.where: Send checklist, step 2, when there are no tracks or crates to send.
review.nothing.approved: No tracks or crates to send

review.leftOut_one.purpose: Warns that one track is left out of the send.
review.leftOut_one.where: Send checklist, step 2, warning above the left-out list.

review.leftOut_other.purpose: Warns how many tracks are left out of the send.
review.leftOut_other.where: Send checklist, step 2, warning above the left-out list.

review.leftOutReason.noFile.purpose: Reason a track is left out: it has no file.
review.leftOutReason.noFile.where: Send checklist, step 2, beside a left-out track.

review.leftOutReason.fileMissing.purpose: Reason a track is left out: its file is missing.
review.leftOutReason.fileMissing.where: Send checklist, step 2, beside a left-out track.

review.leftOutReason.noPath.purpose: Reason a track is left out: its file location can't be worked out.
review.leftOutReason.noPath.where: Send checklist, step 2, beside a left-out track.

review.leftOutReason.pathNotSendable.purpose: Reason a track is left out: its path can't be sent to rekordbox.
review.leftOutReason.pathNotSendable.where: Send checklist, step 2, beside a left-out track.
review.leftOutReason.pathNotSendable.approved: path can't be sent to rekordbox

review.leftOutReason.unsendableCharacter.purpose: Reason a track is left out: a field has a character that can't be sent.
review.leftOutReason.unsendableCharacter.where: Send checklist, step 2, beside a left-out track ({{attribute}} names the field).
review.leftOutReason.unsendableCharacter.approved: {{attribute}} has a character that can't be sent to rekordbox

review.leftOutReason.sameFileAsAnother.purpose: Reason a track is left out: another track already uses the same file.
review.leftOutReason.sameFileAsAnother.where: Send checklist, step 2, beside a left-out track.

review.leftOutReason.rekordboxEntry.purpose: Reason a track is left out: rekordbox's own entry can't be sent back.
review.leftOutReason.rekordboxEntry.where: Send checklist, step 2, beside a left-out track.
review.leftOutReason.rekordboxEntry.approved: rekordbox's entry can't be sent back

review.fileMissing_one.purpose: Warns that one track is sent although its file is missing.
review.fileMissing_one.where: Send checklist, step 2, warning above that list.
review.fileMissing_one.approved: {{count, number}} track sent with file missing (rekordbox's entry is unchanged)

review.fileMissing_other.purpose: Warns that several tracks are sent although their files are missing.
review.fileMissing_other.where: Send checklist, step 2, warning above that list.
review.fileMissing_other.approved: {{count, number}} tracks sent with files missing (rekordbox's entries are unchanged)

review.noFileAtLocation_one.purpose: Warns that one track rekordbox has is sent with rekordbox's own path, and no file is at that path: the app found the track's file somewhere else, but a send never changes the path of a track rekordbox has. rekordbox couldn't find the file before and still won't.
review.noFileAtLocation_one.where: Send checklist, step 2, warning above the list of those tracks.

review.noFileAtLocation_other.purpose: The same warning for several tracks.
review.noFileAtLocation_other.where: Send checklist, step 2, warning above the list of those tracks.

review.otherFile_one.purpose: Warns that one track is in rekordbox with another file, so sending adds a second entry.
review.otherFile_one.where: Send checklist, step 2, warning above that list.
review.otherFile_one.approved: {{count, number}} track in rekordbox with another file (sending adds a second entry)

review.otherFile_other.purpose: Warns that several tracks are in rekordbox with other files, so sending adds second entries.
review.otherFile_other.where: Send checklist, step 2, warning above that list.
review.otherFile_other.approved: {{count, number}} tracks in rekordbox with another file (sending adds a second entry for each)

review.libraryFile.purpose: Labels the Library's file path for a track whose file differs.
review.libraryFile.where: Send checklist, step 2, under a track in the other-file list.

review.rekordboxFile.purpose: Labels rekordbox's file path for a track whose file differs.
review.rekordboxFile.where: Send checklist, step 2, under a track in the other-file list.

review.losesEntries.purpose: Warns that sending replaces rekordbox playlists that will lose tracks.
review.losesEntries.where: Send checklist, step 2, warning above the list of crates sent with tracks left out.
review.losesEntries.approved: Crates sent with tracks left out (rekordbox's playlist of the same name will lose them)

review.losesEntriesRow_one.purpose: One row of that list, one track left out.
review.losesEntriesRow_one.where: Send checklist, step 2, row for a crate ({{name}}) that leaves out one of its tracks.

review.losesEntriesRow_other.purpose: One row of that list, several tracks left out.
review.losesEntriesRow_other.where: Send checklist, step 2, row for a crate ({{name}}) that leaves out several of its tracks.

review.notStored_one.purpose: Warns that one track in the export couldn't be read, and what that means for the send and the Yes answer in rekordbox.
review.notStored_one.where: Send checklist, step 2, warning when one export track couldn't be read.
review.notStored_one.approved: {{count, number}} track in the export couldn't be read. If it's in your Library it's sent as new, and answering Yes in rekordbox will overwrite rekordbox's entry.

review.notStored_other.purpose: Warns that several tracks in the export couldn't be read, and what that means for the send and the Yes answer in rekordbox.
review.notStored_other.where: Send checklist, step 2, warning when several export tracks couldn't be read.
review.notStored_other.approved: {{count, number}} tracks in the export couldn't be read. Any in your Library are sent as new, and answering Yes in rekordbox will overwrite rekordbox's entries.

review.confirm.purpose: Label of the tick box that lets the user send despite the warnings.
review.confirm.where: Send checklist, step 2, shown when the send needs a confirm.

review.refused.incompleteExport.where: Send checklist, step 2, alert when the send is refused.
review.refused.incompleteExport.approved: Can't send: the export is incomplete. Export the collection again from rekordbox.

review.refused.exportOlderThanLastSend.purpose: Refusal: the export was saved before the last send, so it can't show what that send put in rekordbox.
review.refused.exportOlderThanLastSend.where: Send checklist, step 2, alert when the send is refused.
review.refused.exportOlderThanLastSend.approved: Can't send: the export was saved before the last send. Export the collection again from rekordbox.

review.refused.sameName.purpose: Refusal: two crates in one folder share a name.
review.refused.sameName.where: Send checklist, step 2, alert when the send is refused ({{path}} is where).
review.refused.sameName.approved: Can't send: two crates in one folder share a name ({{path}})

review.refused.noName.purpose: Refusal: a crate has no name.
review.refused.noName.where: Send checklist, step 2, alert when the send is refused ({{path}} is where).
review.refused.noName.approved: Can't send: a crate has no name ({{path}})

review.refused.unsendableName.purpose: Refusal: a name has a character rekordbox can't take.
review.refused.unsendableName.where: Send checklist, step 2, alert when the send is refused ({{path}} is where).
review.refused.unsendableName.approved: Can't send: a name has a character rekordbox can't take ({{path}})

review.refused.tooDeep.purpose: Refusal: folders are nested too deep.
review.refused.tooDeep.where: Send checklist, step 2, alert when the send is refused ({{path}} is where).
review.refused.tooDeep.approved: Can't send: folders are nested too deep ({{path}})

review.refused.internal.purpose: Refusal: the file couldn't be made, for an unexpected reason.
review.refused.internal.where: Send checklist, step 2, alert when the send is refused.
review.refused.internal.approved: Can't send: the file couldn't be made. Try again or restart the app.

write.title.purpose: Title of step three, writing the file.

write.path.purpose: Label of the box showing the file's path.
write.path.where: Send checklist, step 3, label of the read-only path box.

write.copy.purpose: Button that copies the file's path.
write.copy.where: Send checklist, step 3, beside the path.

write.copied.where: Send checklist, step 3, status after Copy path worked.

write.copyFailed.purpose: Says copying failed and what to do instead.
write.copyFailed.where: Send checklist, step 3, alert after Copy path failed.
write.copyFailed.approved: Couldn't copy. Select the path and copy it.

write.writing.purpose: Says the file is being written.
write.writing.where: Send checklist, step 3, status while the write runs.

write.written.purpose: Says when the file was written.
write.written.where: Send checklist, step 3, status after a write ({{when}} is a date and time).

failure.readFailed.purpose: Failure: the export couldn't be read (fallback when rekordbox gives no reason).
failure.readFailed.where: Send checklist, step 1, alert when reading fails and the rekordbox source has no reason.

failure.cancelled.where: Send checklist, alert under the step that was cancelled.

failure.noPreflight.purpose: Failure: nothing to write because the export wasn't read.
failure.noPreflight.where: Send checklist, step 3, alert when writing starts without a review.

failure.exportChanged.purpose: Failure: the export file changed after it was read.
failure.exportChanged.where: Send checklist, step 3, alert when writing is refused for that reason.
failure.exportChanged.approved: The export changed after it was read. Read it again.

failure.libraryChanged.purpose: Failure: the Library changed after the review.
failure.libraryChanged.where: Send checklist, step 3, alert when writing is refused for that reason.
failure.libraryChanged.approved: Your Library changed after the review. Read the export again.

failure.notSendable.purpose: Failure: nothing was written because the review found the send unsendable.
failure.notSendable.where: Send checklist, step 3, alert when writing is refused for that reason.
failure.notSendable.approved: Nothing was written. Read the export again.

failure.notConfirmed.purpose: Failure: the user didn't tick Send anyway.
failure.notConfirmed.where: Send checklist, step 3, alert when writing is refused for lack of the confirm.

failure.cantWrite.purpose: Failure: the file couldn't be written; the last file is unchanged.
failure.cantWrite.where: Send checklist, step 3, alert after a failed write.
failure.cantWrite.approved: Can't write the file (the last file is unchanged). Try again.

failure.cantRecord.purpose: Failure: the send couldn't be saved; the user must not import the file.
failure.cantRecord.where: Send checklist, step 3, alert when the file was made but the send couldn't be recorded.
failure.cantRecord.approved: The send couldn't be saved. Don't import the file in rekordbox. Try again.

failure.internal.where: Send checklist, alert under the step that failed.
failure.internal.approved: Something went wrong. Try again or restart the app.

import.title.purpose: Title of step four, importing in rekordbox.

import.show.purpose: Tells the user how to show the rekordbox xml view (first time only).
import.show.approved: In Preferences > View > Layout, tick rekordbox xml (first time only)

import.point.purpose: Tells the user how to point rekordbox at the file (first time only).
import.point.approved: In Preferences > Advanced > Database > rekordbox xml > Imported Library, choose Browse and paste the path (first time only)

import.refresh.purpose: Tells the user to refresh the rekordbox xml view.
import.refresh.approved: In the sidebar, open rekordbox xml and click its refresh icon

import.tracks.purpose: Tells the user how to import the tracks.
import.tracks.approved: Open All Tracks, select every track, right-click and choose Import to Collection

import.dialogsUnknown.purpose: Explains the Yes/No dialogs without a count.
import.dialogsUnknown.where: Send checklist, step 4, fifth bullet, before the export is read.
import.dialogsUnknown.approved: rekordbox asks Yes or No for each track it already has. Answer Yes.

import.dialogsNone.purpose: Says no Yes/No dialogs are expected.
import.dialogsNone.where: Send checklist, step 4, fifth bullet, when no track is already in rekordbox.

import.dialogs_one.purpose: Says to expect one Yes/No dialog and to answer Yes.
import.dialogs_one.where: Send checklist, step 4, fifth bullet, when one track is already in rekordbox.
import.dialogs_one.approved: Expect {{count, number}} Yes/No dialog (for the track rekordbox already has). Answer Yes.

import.dialogs_other.purpose: Says how many Yes/No dialogs to expect and to answer Yes.
import.dialogs_other.where: Send checklist, step 4, fifth bullet, when several tracks are already in rekordbox.
import.dialogs_other.approved: Expect {{count, number}} Yes/No dialogs (one for each track rekordbox already has). Answer Yes.

import.playlists.purpose: Tells the user how to import the playlists.
import.playlists.approved: Under Playlists, right-click Crates and choose Import Playlist. If rekordbox asks to replace playlists with the same name, click OK.

after.title.purpose: Title of step five, what to tidy up after the import.
after.title.where: Send checklist, step 5 (holds the after-send lists).
